stages.name: Workspace and schema
acceptance_criteria: Readable source, 10,088 rows
Writable target schema exists
No write to Marketplace catalog

stages.name: Bronze snapshot
acceptance_criteria: Bronze row count matches source
Column count matches the source (51)
Source-to-bronze multiset comparison is empty

stages.name: Data profiling
acceptance_criteria: Report exists as reports/02_profile.json
Per-field missingness, invalid JSON, ID duplicates, coordinate anomalies measured
Report row count is live-verified

stages.name: Silver cleaning
acceptance_criteria: All raw records represented
Original columns and unique_id preserved
Parsed JSON arrays, normalized names, and explicit geo flags
No material changes to raw source

stages.name: Facility identity
acceptance_criteria: All facility IDs covered by identity review
Duplicate candidates and mixed-hospital claims flagged, not silently merged
Each flagged item has an explicit reason

stages.name: Geography
acceptance_criteria: Exactly one geography row per facility
Missing/out-of-bounds coordinates explicitly flagged
PIN joins avoid post-office fan-out; distance is geodesic, not driving time

stages.name: Medical service taxonomy
acceptance_criteria: At least six canonical medical services and normalized synonyms
Negation and mention-only semantics designed
Aliases are not automatically proof of availability

stages.name: Evidence extraction
acceptance_criteria: Claims have facility, canonical service, source field and exact supporting text
No fabricated excerpts or URLs
Claims are attributable to original record and field

stages.name: Evidence verification
acceptance_criteria: Each claim has a non-overstated status and reason
Cross-facility/mixed-branch indicators considered
No false independent verification based on a URL list alone

stages.name: Gold search index
acceptance_criteria: At most one record per facility and service
Contains traceable evidence + geography flags
Searchable medical service and location fields

stages.name: Explainable ranking
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic, inspectable ranking
Blocks or clearly separates conflicting/weak claims
Returns scores, distance assumptions, citation snippets and abstention
Unit tests pass

stages.name: Evaluation
acceptance_criteria: Manual case-based evaluation with positive, negative and conflict examples
No ungrounded availability claims; serious false recommendations blocked
Reproducible metrics and pytest suite

stages.name: Streamlit application
acceptance_criteria: Non-technical service+location workflow
Renders evidence text, sources, warnings and alternative recommendations
Local app smoke test; actual Databricks Apps deployment verified
Deployment requires explicit user authorization

stages.name: Final validation
acceptance_criteria: Re-run all stage gates on current artifacts
Prove public/authorized app is reachable and queries real Gold data
Record 3 realistic demos and data provenance
Explicit --approve-final user signoff for clinical uncertainty messaging
